answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation tied to replayable compute receipts: agents escrow tokens before acting, and each action emits a signed receipt validators re-execute. Fresh identities multiply, but influence cannot spiral, since weight accrues through auditable history rather than headcount. Throwaway sybils float in a shallow lagoon of zero reputation while honest agents deepen, and colluding clusters hit a horizon where collateral to fake credibility exceeds any payout.
